assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: production illustration for the Rising Steps Unity menu atlas, no controls or lettering. Premium warm inviting children's fantasy adventure aesthetic, detailed but crisp at mobile size. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no screenshots, no watermarks. This is only menu illustration, not simulated gameplay. Landscape 3:2 aspect.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original rectangular 3:2 chapter selection illustration for Rising Steps Unity menu, Temple Trail. Premium stylized 3D fantasy architecture, not a UI mockup. Dry ochre sandstone floating ruins with square masonry ledges, a winding path of carved gold-inlaid stone steps, thick fluted columns, purple fabric banners with small golden diamonds, bronze braziers and gentle flame, a luminous arched temple doorway farther back. Warm golden sunset with a small setting sun to the right, lavender and peach clouds beneath the islands, amber light on carefully carved stone friezes and rounded eroded cliffs. Composition reads instantly as ancient temple adventure at small mobile thumbnail size. High quality sculpted geometry and rich restrained material detail, no black outlines or cheap low-poly shapes. No trees, no grass, no waterfalls, no lake, no people, no text, no buttons, no logos, no watermark. Wide landscape 3:2.
